chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, said:
Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) was handed over to Nahrir, and he used to constrain him and harm him.
He said: Then his wife said to him, "Woe to you! Be wary of Allah. You do not know who is in your house." And she informed him of his righteousness, and said, "Indeed, I fear for you because of him."
So he said, "I will surely throw him among the beasts of prey." Then he did that to him, and he (عليه السلام) was seen standing in salat (prayer) while they were around him.

key_terms.سُلِّمَ: was handed over or delivered into custody
key_terms.يُضَيِّقُ: was constraining, pressuring, or treating harshly

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the righteousness and divine protection of Imam al-Hasan al-Askari (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This report recounts a trial faced by Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Ali (عليه السلام), during which he was mistreated by his custodian. Despite this oppression, his spiritual rank became evident when he was seen standing in salat (prayer) unharmed among predatory beasts, reflecting his righteousness and divine protection.
